Websites for dental clinics / Canada

A clearer online experience for your dental clinic.

Help people find your services, check practical details, and reach your existing appointment-booking tools. Diarva Tech designs clinic marketing websites around clear information and a useful mobile experience.

Discuss your clinic website ↗

Make the next step clear

Useful information.
A straightforward journey.

Explain the services you offer.

Organize your clinic's approved service information into a structure that visitors can browse. Your clinical team supplies and reviews treatment descriptions; website design should not introduce unsupported medical claims.

Make location and hours easy to find.

Present the clinic's verified address, phone number, opening hours, and practical visiting information so people do not have to search across unrelated pages.

Connect the appointment journey.

Give visitors a clear route to your existing booking provider or the clinic's preferred contact method. We define the link or integration approach around the systems you already use.

Work well on smaller screens.

Plan readable content, clear navigation, keyboard access, and comfortable buttons across screen sizes. Keep the important information available without unnecessary visual clutter.

A focused website scope

Plan the essentials
before development.

Start with the clinic's goals, approved content, existing booking tools, and ownership responsibilities. We agree on deliverables and acceptance criteria before building.

  • Content and navigation planning for the clinic's public website
  • Responsive interface design and review
  • Service information, team introductions, location, and contact sections using clinic-supplied details
  • Links to existing appointment tools, with additional integrations scoped separately
  • Search metadata, launch checks, and an agreed content-update approach

Questions from practice owners

Define the right
website project.

Can you redesign our existing dental website?

Yes. We can review its information structure, mobile layout, contact journey, and technical constraints before proposing a scoped redesign or a smaller set of changes.

Can the website connect to our booking provider?

We can review the booking provider's supported links or integrations. Availability, access, and any data-handling requirements need to be confirmed before the scope is agreed.

Will the marketing website collect patient health records?

The marketing website scope described here does not include collecting clinical information or patient health records. Visitors can be directed to the clinic's existing booking provider; additional workflows require a separate review of requirements and data handling.

Can you guarantee more bookings or a first-place Google ranking?

No. A website project can improve the information and interaction experience, but search placement and booking outcomes depend on factors beyond the website implementation. We agree on concrete deliverables rather than promising unsupported results.
